items.note: A full-width yellow band with an ink rule holds the title, lead and filter pills ('All' selected in raised fill), above a dense 4-column grid of outlined cards. Each card has its own sticker object (tote, backpack, duffel, tee, mug, skillet, beanie) on a varied band-color square and a pink price tag, which carries the reference's colorful marketplace wall. The header 'Shop' is an ink-filled current pill and the 24px gaps are even.

The band collapses to the title, lead and a horizontally scrolling pill strip ('Accessories' cropped at the edge as a scroll cue). The filter and sort controls stack in one column and the grid is one column of full-width sticker cards with pink price tags. Nothing overflows sideways.

Black ground with charcoal raised cards, a paper-filled current pill in the header and an ink-filled 'All' pill on the yellow band. Ink text on the band stays dark and readable. The stickers keep heavy black outlines on their bright tiles, and the pink price tags stay the only pink on the cards.

Same one-column mobile structure on the black ground: a charcoal header with a paper-filled 'Shop' pill, a yellow band with the pill strip, and charcoal cards under varied sticker tiles. The hierarchy runs band title, then grid, as on the reference's marketplace pages.

A yellow band carries the breadcrumb, a regular-weight 3xl title and the lead. Below it, a large framed yellow tile holds the tilted tote sticker, beside a pink price tag, outlined radio pills for color, a stepper and a single pink 'Add to cart'. Detail rows are split by hairline rules. In the header neither 'Shop' nor 'Cart' is shown as current.

The layout stacks band, sticker image, price tag, color pills, quantity stepper and pink 'Add to cart' in one column with the action in the flow. The color pills wrap cleanly and the details list keeps its hairline rules. Nothing is cramped or cut.

Dark mapping holds: black ground, the yellow band with ink text, the tote sticker filled charcoal with a black outline on its yellow tile, a raised fill on the selected 'Natural' pill, and the pink price tag and pink 'Add to cart' as the only pink. The two-column split matches the light screen.

A single column on black: the band, the framed sticker tile, a pink price tag, outlined color pills with 'Natural' raised, the stepper and the pink add button. Contrast holds on every element and the footer's two lines wrap cleanly.

Same detail layout as the tote page under the shop's shared yellow band, with a different sticker (a periwinkle sweater on a lime tile) and size pills S–XL with S selected. One pink action and a pink price tag. The header again has no current-page pill (logged under the tote item).

One column: band with breadcrumb and title, sweater sticker tile, price tag, four size pills on one row, stepper, then the pink 'Add to cart'. The vertical rhythm is even and the 'Details' heading follows a 1px ink rule.

Black ground with the same band and the sweater sticker. The neckline turns charcoal in dark mode, and the size pills are outlined with S raised. Pink stays rationed to the price tag and the one add button.
Dark one-column detail page: the pills, stepper and pink button are all readable on black, the sticker tile is framed with radius.md, and the details list rules show as dark hairlines.

The cart section owns a periwinkle band (title plus shipping line), and the header 'Cart' is an ink-filled current pill. The empty state is centered: a pink coin sticker with a yellow extruded rim and a heavy '+' glyph, one sentence, and one pink 'Continue shopping' lift button. This matches the spec's empty-state recipe.

The periwinkle band is collapsed to the title and line, the coin sticker is larger relative to the viewport, and the heading, sentence and single pink button are centered with comfortable spacing. The pink count badge in the header is a small tag, not a second action.

Black ground under the periwinkle band with ink text. The coin sticker switches to a paper outline and '+' so it reads on black, the 'Cart' pill is paper-filled, and one pink button stays the only action.

The dark mobile empty cart has the same order (band, coin sticker with yellow rim, 'Your cart is empty', secondary sentence, pink button) with readable contrast throughout and no stranded space above the footer.

findings.summary: On product detail pages the header nav shows no current pill: 'Shop' is plain text even though the page sits under the shop's band and breadcrumb. The home and cart screens fill their own section's pill.
